answer: Each identity holds one state-issued community radio licence per frequency, listed once as a sparrow call sign, a second claim refused. One weekly slot reads a local fourteen-line sonnet on air, a fingerprint no script can fake. The audit splits each claim like light through a prism: logs and recording must agree, and a live voice proves a human was there. Each fake costs one real station: 1,100 units and 90 days; 100 fakes cost 110,000 units and 9,000 days. Cheapest cheat: renting a station for 800 units a season; the lender surrenders its own licence, and a forged log fails the check.
